SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: CONSERVATION ENVIRONMENT
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES · Grade: Grade 2
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Conservation environment helps you succeed in ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

KEY FACTS: CONSERVATION ENVIRONMENT
Study Conservation environment like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Demonstrate interest in energy they develop. conservationfor conservation for improvement and protection of the environment

What this means
In this part you learn to demonstrate interest in energy they develop. conservationfor conservation for improvement and protection of the environment. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: demonstrate interest in energy they develop. conservationfor conservation for improvement and protection of the environment.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Observe: Name what you can see/touch about “Conservation environment” around your school.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can demonstrate interest in energy they develop. conservationfor conservation for improvement and protection of the environment. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Conservation environment is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name what you can see/touch about “Conservation environment” around your school. (skill: demonstrate interest in energy they develop. conservationfor conservation for improvement and protection of the environment)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Conservation environment to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: demonstrate interest in energy they develop. conservationfor conservation for improvement and protection of the environment.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Conservation environment from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Conservation environment: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 2 learner study Conservation environment?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Conservation environment means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: demonstrate interest in energy they develop. conservationfor conservation for improvement and protection of the environment.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
